title: I built a new catalogue & playtesting platform for indie games - looking for developers and testers
author: WhoSlappedThePie
selftext:
I've spent the last few months building Playtested, a platform aimed at making it easier for indie developers to get structured, useful feedback on their games - and for players to discover interesting indie games worth playing.

It's now live and I'm looking for a small group of developers and testers to start using it properly and help improve it.

For developers:

• Add your game and build a proper game page

• Recruit community playtesters

• Receive structured gameplay, performance, bug and written feedback

• Keep feedback organised against individual builds

• Link players back to Steam/itch.io/your own site

For testers:

• Discover indie games looking for testers

• Claim a playtest and submit structured feedback

• Earn XP when developers mark your feedback as useful

• Build up your tester rank over time

It's free while I'm building the initial community. I'm not asking developers to hand over their game or move away from Steam/itch.io - Playtested is intended to sit alongside those platforms and help with testing and discovery.

I'm particularly interested in developers with playable builds who'd be willing to try the workflow and tell me what works, what doesn't, and what's missing and interested in testers working to a structured form and being able to claim/download/review games easily.

I've already had some useful developer feedback and I'm actively making changes from it, so early users will have a genuine influence over where this goes.

Playtested: [playtested.co.uk](http://playtested.co.uk/)

If you're developing an indie game or enjoy playtesting them, I'd love to hear what you think and get you involved.
